placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Battery Point is a place to stop and take in the scale of the Severn Estuary. The navigation light, passing shipping and views towards Wales offer plenty to notice without planning a long hike.

Combine a visit to the viewpoint with a short walk along the Esplanade. Our family idea: take turns describing a distant object for everyone else to find, then pause on a public seat for a snack.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Ship spotting and a short coastal outing with confident walkers.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Public seats at the point; seafront refreshments nearby.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use signed Lake Grounds or seafront parking, observing local restrictions.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Access includes steps or uneven paths. Keep back from the edges; the water has strong currents and is not a swimming spot.
